result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a restaurant name is clipped by overlapping content in the popular listings section.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is cut off at the end ('Ramer'), with the final letter obscured where it meets the rating area.
issues.suggestion: Give the title enough horizontal space or allow it to wrap/truncate with an ellipsis so the full name remains readable and does not collide with the rating.
